verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents official client SDKs for Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, and Ruby with idiomatic interfaces, type safety, streaming, retries, and error handling, plus a CLI and Admin/Usage APIs, covering the full agentic build surface (tool use, MCP connector, structured outputs, batching). Missing for 10: independent developer corroboration (e.g. GitHub stars/issues, third-party tutorials) confirming real-world SDK usage beyond first-party docs.
